configuration.command: adb -s <device> shell 'getprop ro.build.version.release; getprop ro.build.version.sdk; getprop ro.lineage.version; getprop ro.build.type; getprop ro.zygote; getprop dalvik.vm.usap_pool_enabled; device_config get activity_manager enable_wait_for_finish_attach_application; dumpsys activity settings | grep -E "process_start_async|ENABLE_WAIT_FOR_FINISH_ATTACH_APPLICATION"'

settings_record.command: adb -s <device> shell 'dumpsys activity processes com.android.settings | grep -E "ProcessRecord|thread=|startSeq=|pendingStart=|pendingFinishAttach|mPendingStarts|pid=|packageList="'
